review:
A fruit-machine jackpot game on 16 reels, and one of Wazdan's gentler titles: medium volatility, a 500x top prize and a 96.13% RTP.

The Cash Out symbol can land on a random reel and stay for up to 15 spins, then pays a random prize plus the other values in its column. Cash Infinity symbols stick until the Hold the Jackpot bonus ends. Chance Level helps you reach the bonus more often. Hold-and-win with smaller swings.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
